title: My busy timetable
instructions: Öğrenci Sara haftalık programını anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; günleri ve saatleri dikkatle eşleştir. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: sara
script.text: I'm Sara, and I'm a university student. My week is very busy.

script.speaker: sara
script.text: On Mondays, I have classes from nine to three. Then I work in a café from four to eight.

script.speaker: sara
script.text: On Tuesdays, I only have one class, at eleven. In the afternoon, I study in the library.

script.speaker: sara
script.text: On Wednesdays, I go to the gym in the morning and have classes in the afternoon.

script.speaker: sara
script.text: Thursday is my favourite day. I have no classes, so I sleep late and meet my friends.

script.speaker: sara
script.text: On Fridays, I work in the café again, from ten to six.

script.speaker: sara
script.text: At the weekend, I visit my parents. They live two hours away by train.

script.speaker: sara
script.text: I'm always tired on Sunday evening, but I like my life.

questions.evidence: Then I work in a café from four to eight.

questions.prompt: When is Sara's only class on Tuesday?

questions.feedback: Perşembe dersi yok; geç uyuyup arkadaşlarıyla buluşuyor.
